 Avril Lavigne reveals she’s secretly welcomed a baby girl with mystery man: ‘Princess’ 
 By 
 Eric Todisco 
 Published 
 Nov. 13, 2026, 10:56 a.m. ET 
 See more of our coverage in your search results. 
 Make Page Six a Preferred Source 
 Avril Lavigne is a mom!
 The singer, 42, welcomed her first child, a daughter, with a mystery man, she announced on Friday.
 “Our Mini F—ing Princess has arrived 🎀👑🍼🩷,” Lavigne wrote on Instagram alongside the first photos of her newborn. 
 8 
 Avril Lavigne announced on Friday that she welcomed her first child, a daughter, with a mystery man. Instagram/ Avril Lavigne 
 8 
 The singer shared the first photos of her newborn daughter on her Instagram. Instagram/ Avril Lavigne 
 8 
 Lavigne included a picture of three pairs of Vans sneakers. Instagram/ Avril Lavigne 
 In the first picture, Lavigne and her mystery partner held their baby daughter’s hand.
 The next image showed the “Complicated” singer cradling her newborn, who was dressed in a cheetah-print outfit.
 Lavigne also shared a picture of three pairs of Vans sneakers — seemingly belonging to her, her mystery partner and their daughter.
 8 
 Lavigne was last seen publicly in April leaving the Chateau Marmont Hotel in Los Angeles after partying with friends. The Hollywood Curtain / BACKGRID 
 8 
 Lavigne (seen above) reportedly performed at an after-party for Taylor Swift and Travis Kelce’s wedding in NYC in July. The Hollywood Curtain / BACKGRID 
 Lavigne was last seen publicly in April leaving the Chateau Marmont Hotel in Los Angeles after partying with friends. 
 The pop-punk superstar wore a baggy black-and-white sweatshirt, fishnet leggings and tall black boots.
 In July, Lavigne was a surprise performer at an after-party for Taylor Swift and Travis Kelce’s New York City nuptials, according to reports.

 The “Sk8er Boi” singer took home a Chanel handbag in the wedding raffle, Page Six Hollywood exclusively reported .
 Lavigne’s last publicly known partner is rapper Tyga, whom she started dating in early 2023 .
 The pair were pictured kissing at Paris Fashion Week in March that year, as a source told People that the two were “very into each other” and “spending a lot of time together.”
 8 
 Lavigne performed at the 2025 Rock and Roll Hall of Fame Induction Ceremony one year before she announced her daughter’s birth. FilmMagic 
 8 
 Lavigne’s last known public relationship was with rapper Tyga. They broke up for good in October 2023 after several months of dating. Corbis via Getty Images 
 However, the insider insisted Lavigne and Tyga, 36, “were not exclusive” and “taking things very slowly to be on the safe side.”
 Lavigne and Tyga broke up in June 2023 , before reuniting in Las Vegas the next month. 
 That October, People confirmed their romance was “totally done.”

 Before Tyga, Lavigne was engaged to fellow singer Mod Sun . They called it quits in February 2023 , which appeared to come as a surprise to the “Karma” singer.
 “They were together and engaged as of three days ago when he left for tour, so if anything has changed, that’s news to him,” Mod Sun’s rep told us at the time.
 Lavigne was previously married to Sum 41 singer Deryck Whibley from 2006 to 2010, and to Nickelback singer Chad Kroeger from 2013 to 2015. 
 8 
 Her first marriage was to Deryck Whibley (pictured here in 2007) from 2006 to 2010. WireImage 
 She also dated billionaire Phillip Sarofim  for one year, breaking up in 2019, and reality star Brody Jenner for two years, splitting in 2012.
 While married to Kroeger, Lavigne explained her hopes for motherhood.
 “I want one or two [kids], but not right now,” she told E! News in 2013. “Like, in the future. Eventually.”
